## Description

Add the shadcn `Table` set (Table, TableHeader, TableBody, TableRow, TableHead, TableCell, TableCaption, scroll wrapper) to `packages/ui` through the shadcn CLI, with tokens, logical utilities for right-to-left, sticky header, numeric columns and 44 px row targets. Sorting, filtering and paging state goes in a `useXxxTableController` hook (TanStack Query for server data; add a table helper library only with a reason in the PR), column definitions are plain data in `domain/`, and components only render the rows they are given. Replace the raw tables in DaySheetView, MergeReview, AuditLogPanel and StaffPanel. Add a lint rule that rejects raw table elements in features.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given a feature file, when it contains a raw table, tr, td or th element, then lint fails.
- [ ] **AC2.** Given the four existing screens, when they render, then they use the shared Table and look and behave as before (keyboard, focus ring, axe clean, Arabic right-to-left).
- [ ] **AC3.** Given a sortable column, when a user sorts it, then aria-sort is set and the state lives in the controller hook, not the component.
- [ ] **AC4.** Given an empty, loading or error result, when the table renders, then each state is shown through the shared pattern.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
